mu_name_from: OpenMU Version075 Items/Weapons.cs:114 and mu.db's items row (code 520, group 1, index 8) name it the Crescent Axe against Item/Axe09.bmd. Identical in 0.95d (Weapons.cs:122) and Season 6 (:180).
why_this_one: The Cyclops's weapon in MuMain: CreateMonster's case MONSTER_CYCLOPS sets `c->Weapon[0].Type = MODEL_CRESCENT_AXE` (ZzzCharacter.cpp:14065). Drop level 54: in the Dungeon only the Gorgon (55) reaches it (docs/dungeon-port.md A §1.7).
classes_from: wizardClass 1, knightClass 1, elfClass 0 in the call: the one axe of 0.75 a Dark Wizard may carry, and the one that asks Agility beside Strength.
stance_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp:356-368: a sword, axe or mace that is TwoHand (width 2) stands PLAYER_STOP_TWO_HAND_SWORD.
two_handed_from: Width 2 in the call; OpenMU's `group < Bows && width == 2` and MuMain's ItemAttribute TwoHand agree.
sheet_from: Data/Item/Axes10.OZJ (64x64, no alpha), from MuMain. The .bmd's one mesh reads Axes10.jpg (112 triangles).
material_overrides_note: The Devias batch's settling for steel on a weapon (0.45; plate 0.5 on a pole): steel's own 0.2 mirrors the grass. Set before the first look.
material_note: Axes10 read at 6x: the crescent blade fills most of the sheet, bright steel with a dark engraved serpent-scroll along its spine and a soft black shadow painted round its edge; a thin dark steel bar at the top middle; a ribbed pale strip at the top right, the grip's wrap. Blade and bar steel, the wrap leather_wrap.
islands_from: Five islands for 112 triangles. 0 (8, the whole length of the pole, the dark bar at the sheet's top middle) is the haft: plate_steel at 0.5, as the Devias poles. 1-3 (14 each, three runs along the pole on the ribbed pale strip) are the grip wraps: leather_wrap. 4 (62, the whole sheet) is the crescent head: steel at 0.45. They arrived as steel, the weapon profile's default.
